name: Product development at the system level

checks.title: Functional Safety Concept (FSC) defined
checks.description: Verify existence of FSC capturing safety goals, functional safety requirements, and assumptions/constraints.

checks.title: Technical Safety Concept (TSC) consistent with FSC
checks.description: Check TSC derives technical safety requirements and safety mechanisms consistent with FSC and item assumptions.

checks.title: System architecture with safety allocation
checks.description: Confirm system architecture shows allocation of safety requirements, interfaces, and independence where needed.

checks.title: ASIL decomposition rationale
checks.description: If ASIL decomposition applied, verify rationale, independence (sufficient), and impact on safety mechanisms.

checks.title: Validation plan at system level
checks.description: Verify existence of a safety validation plan referencing safety goals, scenarios, pass/fail criteria.

checks.title: System integration and test plan
checks.description: Check system integration strategy and test plan with traceability to safety requirements.
